bullets.text: the rice cooker played its little song at six. nobody clapped. it waited a beat, like it expected an encore.
❂ overcast at okunoin. the duck carries a line about the measure of the universe. a cedar keeps its own count, in rings.
measuring a shelf for the third time. the shelf hasn't changed. the tape measure is starting to doubt me.
leaves in the gutter. the rain found another way down, mostly onto my left shoe.
